unsupportedNativeFeatures.limitation: Contracts validate description shape only; no adapter, transport or persistence behaviour is proven here
Round trips are exercised against real v1 projects built in-process; no HTTP import/export route is involved at this layer
The schema proves a claim's shape and internal consistency; whether an issuer actually observed what it reports is an adapter and command-layer obligation
Canaries are asserted absent from projection output; server-side logging, error bodies and storage are other swarms' surfaces
The refinement constrains how an issue may be reported; it cannot verify that an importer classified a construct correctly
JSON Schema checks structure only; every cross-field refinement is runtime-only and is asserted as such in CON-06-04

change.change: Added IDENTIFIER_LIMITS; identifiers, versions and safe text now also reject bidirectional controls and blank-only values; connectorReferenceSchema rejects reserved object keys and traversal; canonicalConnectorJson throws RangeError past depth 256.
change.compatibility: Additive and strictly narrowing on inputs that were never valid upstream data. Every previously exported name keeps its shape; no accepted realistic identifier changed. Callers that constructed a reference from an attacker-controlled path now get a parse error instead of a path-shaped key.

change.change: New module: JSON_VALUE_LIMITS, measureJsonValue, boundedJsonGuard, isReservedObjectKey. Exported from the connectors barrel.

nativeExtensionsSchema is now a z.preprocess guard over the raw value (depth/nodes/bytes/string/reserved-key bounds) rather than two post-parse refinements; added EXTENSION_LIMITS, liveEvidenceLevels, compatibilitySeverities, claimIssuers, lifecycleTransitions, canTransitionLifecycle, parseNormalizedDefinition, sourceRecordShape and refineSourceRecord; DEFINITION_LIMITS gained declaredServers and extensionBytes; refineNormalizedDefinition now also takes events and nativeExtensions; several refinements added (listed per work item).
change.compatibility: Additive exports plus narrowing refinements. nativeExtensionsSchema keeps the same inferred type (Record<string, unknown>) and the same JSON Schema output; it now refuses a reserved key instead of silently dropping it. sourceRecordSchema was split into shape + refinement because Zod 4 forbids .omit() on a refined object and envelope.ts needs the portable variant; sourceRecordSchema itself is unchanged in shape and behaviour. refineNormalizedDefinition's parameter type widened, which affects only callers inside this directory.

change.change: Added normalizedDigestOf and verifyNormalizedDigest; portableSourceSchema built from sourceRecordShape; upgrade derives profile ids and display text safely from v1 spellings; downgrade emits eight further coded diagnostics.
change.compatibility: Additive. Envelopes produced before this change still parse; the digest helper is new, so nothing depended on the previous (identical for the v1 path) digest input. Existing diagnostics keep their codes and severities.

change.change: Nine connector schema entries added to specificationSchemas.
change.compatibility: Entries only; the eleven existing schemas and their generated documents are untouched.

change.change: Found on disk during this swarm's run: eventDescriptorSchema gained optional `authentication` and `nativeExtensions`, with matching checks in refineNormalizedDefinition.
change.compatibility: Additive and consistent with this profile, so it was kept rather than reverted; it changed connector-definition-v1 and connector-envelope-v2, which were regenerated. Noted here because src/core/connectors/** is CONTRACT-owned and the change did not come through a ledger patch.

patch.description: Add the new profile page to the contract-stack table and mention the nine new schemas: | [Connector interoperability](connector-interoperability.md) | Source provenance, normalized definitions, the v2 envelope, evidence, lifecycle and projections | Server-approved runtime bindings and verified provider evidence |. The sentence 'The complete schema set is ...' should also name connector-source-v1, connector-definition-v1, connector-envelope-v2, capability-status-v1, verification-claim-v1, compatibility-issue-v1, catalog-entry-v1, connection-summary-v1 and binding-reference-v1.
Add CON-01..CON-06 to the executable-mapping table pointing at tests/connectors/contracts/*.test.ts, and note that connector structural drift is covered by CON-06-01 in addition to SPEC-10.
Link docs/specifications/connector-interoperability.md from the documentation index beside the existing formal-specifications entry.

SPEC-10 iterates specificationSchemas and therefore already covers the nine new documents; no change is required. If a focused connector drift case is wanted, CON-06-01 in tests/connectors/contracts/schemas.test.ts already asserts it.
If a focused script is wanted: "test:connectors": "node --import tsx --test tests/connectors/**/*.test.ts". Not added here (package.json is integrator-owned and this swarm must not edit it).
